decisions.reason: Although not central to the announced software-defined direction, prior investment and public commitment still favour persistence, so withdrawal is relatively unlikely.
As a central data-centre interconnection product with visible adoption and heavy sunk investment, management remains strongly committed and very unlikely to withdraw.
The dedicated product page and core optical connectivity position signal high visibility and commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely under escalation of commitment.
The portal is less central to the future direction but has accumulated investment and responsibility, so management persists despite limited visibility.
Although it is a legacy telephony service, sunk costs and public commitment continue to weigh, and weak results are still attributed to the industry downturn.
